opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grant – Autumn 2026 round

amount.raw: up to £20,000 (New Projects, Acquisitions, Long‑Term Research); up to £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures, Publications); up to £2,500 (Research & Travel)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non‑profit organisations for exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conferences, publications and long‑term research; individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for research & travel grants.
